All signs.voice_body:
SEIZE THE PIVOT! Venus, the lover of life, is turning back on 4 Oct 2026, signalling a moment to re‑evaluate what feels true. The Sun’s hard opposition to Saturn adds a test of discipline: the energy that once pushed forward now asks for patience. Together they urge you to pause, reflect on your values, and gently adjust your course.  

Take a quiet walk, note what feels authentic, and set a single intention to align your actions with that truth.
